ValidationRule.description: This is to block users from changing order status when it is activated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Draft"), OR (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status), "SentToSAP"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "OrderReceivedBySAP")
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Order status cannot be changed back when order has been activated.
